transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, I came in because... people have actually started noticing how I'm moving lately. Sometimes it's like I'm moving underwater. It takes me forever just to answer a question or even get up out of a chair. 

But then other times, it's the opposite. I'll just be pacing back and forth in my apartment, rubbing my hands together like... I don't know, like I'm trying to shake off a bad call from work. It's just getting really obvious to people, so I figured I should get it checked out.
Along with these changes in your movement, how has your mood been feeling lately?

I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. I mean... I haven't really noticed anything specific going on with my mood. I guess I've just been so focused on the physical stuff, like the pacing and feeling slow, that I haven't paid much attention to how I'm feeling otherwise. So, yeah, I don't think my mood has been all that different. Just kind of normal, I guess.
Are you currently taking any prescription medications?
No, I'm not taking any prescription medications right now. Um... I don't really take anything at all, to be honest. Just, you know, maybe ibuprofen if I get a headache, but that's about it.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people cannot hear or see?

Yeah, actually. I guess I have been hearing a few things. It's usually when I'm at home and my work laptop is completely shut down. I'll hear the beep of my work headset, like a call is coming in, even though there's no phone ringing anywhere. And sometimes, I'll hear a voice—it sounds like one of my supervisors—just saying my name, or saying "too slow." It's weird because I know I'm not logged in, but I hear it clear as day.
Have you recently had any medical illnesses, infections, or head injuries?
No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick lately, no infections... and I definitely haven't hit my head or had any injuries. Physically, I've been perfectly healthy in that regard.
About how long have you been noticing these voices and changes in your movement?

I'd say it's been about a year and eight months since I started noticing the voices, and... well, the feeling that I'm being tracked. And it's not just happening when I'm at my lowest or feeling the worst of the sadness. They've been around even when my mood is otherwise okay.
Over the past year and eight months, roughly how much of that total time have you experienced periods of severe sadness or mood problems?

Well, honestly, the depression side of things has been going on even longer than the voices. I'd say the severe sadness has been present for about two years and a month now. There are only brief periods where it eases up, but for the most part, it's just been a constant heavy feeling for that whole time.
